Rationale: The Ground Truth LISP `(AND Issue (JOIN Cancellation_date 2010-09-17))` identifies the `Issue` entity that has a `Cancellation_date` of `2010-09-17`. The Candidate, however, targets the `cancellation_date` attribute itself and filters by a different `date` attribute, effectively answering 'When was the event on 2010-09-17 cancelled?' instead of 'What was cancelled on 2010-09-17?'. This mismatch in the target (returning an attribute instead of the entity) constitutes a structural error.
